summary: Louisiana-Pacific filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing that its Board declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.30 per common share, payable December 4, 2026, to holders of record November 20, 2026; the accompanying press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No price, premium, stake, advisor, or transaction terms are stated. This is an ordinary capital-return declaration under Item 8.01, not a special situation, and the filing carries no deal mechanics, regulatory clock, or structural overhang to monitor.
